sources: exact all16 T1 sources, same observed counts and same four screening request bases; preserve all T1 losses
input_universe: union of T1 input CI strings plus physical HF; these request bases were selected before their CI energies
global_rank: equal average of alpha/beta CI marginal probabilities across all4 fixed screen eigenstates; HF then score descending then numeric ID
frequency_control: same input universe, actual original spin counts, HF then descending count then numeric ID; no CI screening needed operationally
native_control: official Trim.refine ratio1, per-trim cap128, same native spin-sym/include_HF/order-preserving max_dim rules; not local quarter trimming
cardinality: all3 arms min(128,union size); exactly same actual final CI dimension within each source
screen_reuse: all80 T1 CIs preserved/reused; no repeat; retain old screen costs separately from incremental work
operational_cost: global/native need4 screens only when input union exceedsR; frequency never needs the screening CI solves. Campaign costs include T1 and all newly evaluated T2 arms; do not pretend all arms pay unnecessary CI work
cache_reuse: same physical problem/orbitals/penalty/basis/numerical settings only; retain source evaluation and inherited CI cost; identical arms or old R2/T1 spaces are not new independent root evaluations
limitations: not a claim of novel marginal ranking
same max/actual space is not matched actual CPU
no automatic superiority claim or new-shot expansion
